premise: Everyone waits for the Earth to set the way the Moon sets back home — but it hangs over the ridge in the same spot, day and night.
inspiration: The nursery rhyme 'I see the Moon, and the Moon sees me', turned: from the Moon, it's the Earth that keeps watch.
lesson: Some friends are always right where you left them.
learning: From this side of the Moon, the Earth stays in almost the same place in the sky.

en-US.title: The Earth Stays Put
en-US.text: [curious] Back on Earth, the Moon rises and sets. Up it comes over the hills, across the sky it goes, and down it sinks again. So everyone at the base wondered: when would the Earth set? {all:pulse} {all:glow 0.4} They watched it, hanging blue and white just over the far ridge. {canvas:satellites 0.6 14s} Little lights crept by among the stars. {all:face surprised} But the Earth stayed put. An hour went by. {all:wobble} Still there. A day went by. {all:shake 0.4} Still there. A whole week! {all:hop x2} STILL there! [laughs] {all:spin} The Earth wasn't going anywhere. From this side of the Moon, it hangs in almost the same spot, day and night, all month long. {all:sparkle} [warmly] {all:face happy} So everyone waved good morning to it, and good night, {all:hearts} and it was always right there, keeping watch.

es-ES.title: La Tierra no se mueve
es-ES.text: [curious] En la Tierra, la Luna sale y se pone. Asoma por las colinas, cruza el cielo y vuelve a bajar. Así que en la base todos se preguntaban: ¿cuándo se pondría la Tierra? {all:pulse} {all:glow 0.4} La miraban, azul y blanca, justo encima de las montañas. {canvas:satellites 0.6 14s} Unas lucecitas pasaban despacio entre las estrellas. {all:face surprised} Pero la Tierra no se movía. Pasó una hora. {all:wobble} Seguía allí. Pasó un día. {all:shake 0.4} Seguía allí. ¡Una semana entera! {all:hop x2} ¡SEGUÍA allí! [laughs] {all:spin} La Tierra no pensaba irse a ningún sitio. Desde este lado de la Luna, se queda casi en el mismo lugar, de día y de noche, todo el mes. {all:sparkle} [warmly] {all:face happy} Así que todos le daban los buenos días, y las buenas noches, {all:hearts} y ella siempre estaba allí, vigilando.
